lines.text: Are the footprints still there? On the Moon.
lines.phonemes: ɑːɹ ðə fˈʊtpɹɪnts stˈɪl ðˈɛɹ? ɔnðə mˈuːn.

lines.text: In nineteen sixty-nine, Apollo astronauts walked in the Moon's dust. Since then, an orbiter has photographed the Apollo 11 landing site. The tracks are still there.
lines.phonemes: ɪn nˈaɪntiːn sˈɪkstinˈaɪn, ɐpˈɑːloʊ ˈæstɹənˌɔːts wˈɔːkt ɪnðə mˈuːnz dˈʌst. sˈɪns ðˈɛn, ɐn ˈɔːɹbɪɾɚ hɐz fˈoʊɾəɡɹˌæft ðɪ ɐpˈɑːloʊ ɪlˈɛvən lˈændɪŋ sˈaɪt. ðə tɹˈæks ɑːɹ stˈɪl ðˈɛɹ.

lines.text: On Earth, wind and rain wipe a footprint out in days. The Moon has almost no air, so no wind and no rain.
lines.phonemes: ˌɔn ˈɜːθ, wˈɪnd ænd ɹˈeɪn wˈaɪp ɐ fˈʊtpɹɪnt ˈaʊt ɪn dˈeɪz. ðə mˈuːn hɐz ˈɔːlmoʊst nˈoʊ ˈɛɹ, sˌoʊ nˈoʊ wˈɪnd ænd nˈoʊ ɹˈeɪn.

lines.text: Only slow things wear a print down. Tiny space grains keep hitting the dust, one at a time. That sandblasting wears the Moon down about a millimeter every million years.
lines.phonemes: ˈoʊnli slˈoʊ θˈɪŋz wˈɛɹ ɐ pɹˈɪnt dˈaʊn. tˈaɪni spˈeɪs ɡɹˈeɪnz kˈiːp hˈɪɾɪŋ ðə dˈʌst, wˈʌn æɾə tˈaɪm. ðæt sˈændblæstɪŋ wˈɛɹz ðə mˈuːn dˌaʊn ɐbˌaʊt ɐ mˈɪlɪmˌiːɾɚɹ ˈɛvɹi mˈɪliən jˈɪɹz.

lines.text: Pull back from one boot print to the whole site. The lander's base and the tracks are still where the astronauts left them, as orbiters show.
lines.phonemes: pˈʊl bˈæk fɹʌm wˈʌn bˈuːt pɹˈɪnt tə ðə hˈoʊl sˈaɪt. ðə lˈændɚz bˈeɪs ænd ðə tɹˈæks ɑːɹ stˈɪl wˌɛɹ ðɪ ˈæstɹənˌɔːts lˈɛft ðˌɛm, æz ˈɔːɹbɪɾɚz ʃˈoʊ.

lines.text: No beach on Earth keeps a footprint like that. Look up tonight: some of them may still be there.
lines.phonemes: nˈoʊ bˈiːtʃ ˌɔn ˈɜːθ kˈiːps ɐ fˈʊtpɹɪnt lˈaɪk ðˈæt. lˈʊk ˌʌp tənˈaɪt: sˌʌm ʌv ðˌɛm mˈeɪ stˈɪl biː ðˈɛɹ.

lines.text: Light time to the Moon: about one point three seconds. Close enough to talk, with a short wait.
lines.phonemes: lˈaɪt tˈaɪm tə ðə mˈuːn: ɐbˌaʊt wˈʌn pˈɔɪnt θɹˈiː sˈɛkəndz. klˈoʊs ɪnˈʌf tə tˈɔːk, wɪð ɐ ʃˈɔːɹt wˈeɪt.

lines.text: That's season two. Next: another orbit, another question, same sky.
lines.phonemes: ðæts sˈiːzən tˈuː. nˈɛkst: ɐnˈʌðɚɹ ˈɔːɹbɪt, ɐnˈʌðɚ kwˈɛstʃən, sˈeɪm skˈaɪ.
